👨‍🍳 How to Play

1️⃣ Look at each customer's order.
2️⃣ Tap BURGER, FRIES, or KEBAB to cook it.
3️⃣ When the food is on the tray, tap SERVE for the correct customer.
🔥 Serve quickly to build a Combo and earn more coins.
